name: Energy and Water Data Disclosure for Local Law 84 2016 (Data for Calendar Year 2015)
description:
This dataset contains New York City building-level energy and water benchmarking data disclosed under Local Law 84 for calendar year 2015, covering a sample of about 5,000 properties across the five boroughs. Each record describes a building's identity and location (address, borough, block and lot, coordinates, community board, council district, census tract), its size, year built, occupancy, and mix of property uses, alongside detailed performance metrics. These include site and source energy use intensity, Energy Star scores, consumption by fuel type (natural gas, electricity, fuel oil, district steam and chilled water), greenhouse gas emissions, and water use, with national medians provided for comparison. The data also include data-quality flags and alerts indicating estimated or potentially problematic values.

The dataset supports comparisons of energy and water efficiency across building types and boroughs, identification of high-consumption or high-emissions properties, and analysis of how building characteristics relate to performance. It is useful for energy policy and sustainability research
